review.note: M53: written on Wikidata’s Q861551 — P571 1626, P576 1804-01-01 — so that `saint-domingue-and-the-french-sugar-colony` and `haitian-revolution-1791-1804` can name the polity they are about. Its dissolution is the same day `haiti` on Q790 gives for its own inception, but `haiti` in this atlas is the CShapes record beginning 1886, so no succession is written: that is the same 1886 question M49 left open. It holds no ground.

summary: A polity whose inception Wikidata states as 1626 on Q861551 and whose dissolution it states as 1804-01-01. Both years here are those two values and nothing else. It is the French colony in the western third of Hispaniola, and it is written because two events of the Caribbean chain are about it and neither could name anybody: the atlas has `hispaniola-spain` and `santo-domingo-spain` for the Spanish side and nothing at all for the French one, and `haiti` begins in 1886, where CShapes begins. It holds no territory; the island’s outlines in both imports belong to the records already there.
